heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: BNPB chief Suharyanto briefed President Prabowo on 7 September that the death toll has risen to 135 — split for the first time into 48 direct and 87 indirect deaths — with 1,752 injured, while displacement plunged to 72,864, well below both BNPB's own prior 166,829 figure and BPBD NTT's competing 96,385 count from 5 September. Home-damage verification reached 50.39% (51,591 of 102,384 identified units), and the cumulative aftershock count hit 13,156 as weekly activity fell sharply to 364 tremors. BNPB says health, education, economic and social activities are beginning to normalize as the response shifts into the rehabilitation-reconstruction phase.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
